I'm not convinced about the surrounding businesses and have concentrated my search on the Comet property since that seems most suspect.

William Street heading north from this property goes into a mini ‘Chinatown’ with various Asian restaurants, grocery stores and small businesses. That in itself is a whole other can of worms, not immediately Pizza but possibly.

South from this property goes into an entertainment precinct, where nightclubs, cafes, boutique/alternative fashion shops and small art galleries are seen. Being close to the TAFE College which has a large art dept, and Art Gallery of WA, State Theatre of WA and WA Museum means there will be a lot of arty types hanging around so of course art is important in this part of town. Perth has a lot of govt sponsored graffiti and murals with a few wannabe Banksy’s so it's not unusual to see large public artworks.

The 'Awesome' childrens' festival is held annually on an open-air plaza in front of the state art gallery and museum, nothing sinister there unless some autists can find something on the people in the organisation. The map link on this website goes to Nov 2009 google street view, so this medical centre was listed sometime between Nov 09 and Feb 2014 which is the next street view date. Looking at all the street views, the property is vacant and boarded up the entire time, certainly not used as a medical centre. Nov 2007 streetview it is an Asian convenience store. Appears to be occupied due to flags/bunting across the verandah in front of the doorway.

Nov 2009 streetview still the Asian convenience store, still occupied and door is open on this day.

Feb 2014 streetview Vacant for some time, judging by graffiti. August 2015 streetview still boarded up, better view of murals on hoarding and the new murals on buildings behind.

Oct 2015 streetview still vacant, no significant changes.
